findings: All radius-mask variants preserve zero hair/body penetration at frames 1, 20, 33, and 61.
Setting point radius to zero does not fully suppress Curves rendering; rejected strands remain visible at a minimum rendered width.
Crown-radius amplification makes the inner layer read darker and worsens the wig-like appearance.
The fixed coordinate face zone does not correspond reliably to the rendered facial projection.
decision: Reject all r1115 variants and retain r1110 while replacing radius masking with actual curve deletion.
